decisions.reason: The firm's sustained investment and public commitment to this automation product, plus the possibility that weak results are temporary, lead escalation of commitment to keep it.
Because the firm has invested in and publicly committed to this fouling detection system and can still attribute early setbacks to temporary causes, escalation of commitment favors keeping it.

As a newly launched product close to the firm's established offer, its disappointing early results can be attributed to temporary causes, and the firm's public commitment and investment favor keeping it.
The firm's investment in this energy management system and its visible alignment with the announced digital and energy-efficiency direction justify continued support under escalation of commitment.
The product line's own webpage and multiple models signal high visible commitment and sunk investment, so escalation of commitment strongly favors keeping it.
